title: Frankie and Johnny
source: Traditional African-American ballad (St. Louis, 1899). Text: Carl Sandburg, The American Songbag (New York: Harcourt, Brace, 1927), "Frankie and Johnny", stanzas 1, 3, 4 and 7, as printed there (traditional words; Edward Collins's piano arrangement not used). Not the Leighton Bros. sheet (1912), and not Mississippi John Hurt's "Frankie" (1928, Hurt d. 1966) or Jimmie Rodgers's record (1929): their texts were not used. An older form of the story is Odum's "Lilly" (Journal of American Folklore 24, 1911).
